bootstrap.rollout_excess_field_is_not_the_gate_qua: the bootstrap's rollout_excess field is the median of the per-window difference (rollout - encoded_target); gate G9 is the difference of the two medians. The bootstrap bounds the sampling of a related quantity, not of the gate value itself, and its report says so in its own field.

frozen.e1_is_conditioned_on_more_actions_at_the: DECLARED BEFORE THE RUN. The evaluator rolls out max(HORIZONS)=16 action steps and reads step 8, for every arm. Under action_chunk=4 the step-8 latent of arm E1 therefore depends on actions 0..10, while E0/E2/E3 depend on actions 0..7. A horizon-8 CEM could not supply actions 8..10; at plan time those slots zero-pad, which is a different computation from the one gated here. So the E1 - E0 contrast is 'joint chunk conditioning AND three extra future actions at the readout horizon', not chunk conditioning alone. The 16-step rollout is required for the cohort-identity assertion to hold, so it is kept and the confound is declared instead of removed. If E1 is the winning arm, the next protocol MUST re-measure it under planner-consistent zero-padding before any of its numbers are carried forward.

g9_reading_condition.rationale: 1.5x v3 arm B's 2.59 cm encoder term. Inside this band G9 is read; outside it the split is not comparable to v3's and G9 is reported as uninterpretable rather than as a pass. A reading rule only: it never changes G9's threshold or its pass/fail computation. It is necessary, NOT sufficient: an encoder degraded to, say, 3.5 cm would sit inside the band and could still post a small excess, which is why no outcome depends on G9.

g9_threshold_derivation.a_pass_does_not_restore_v2: at 0.53 cm the excess is still 36 % above v2's carried-over 0.39 cm. Passing G9 halves the v2->v3 regression; it does not undo it.
g9_threshold_derivation.declared_consequence: G9 can pass while G1 fails: 0.53 cm on top of arm B's 2.59 cm encoder term is a rollout of about 3.1 cm, still about 2.1x G1's threshold. An arm that passes G9 and fails G1 has not passed the gate set.

not_passable_by_identity_predictor.note: persistence minus encoded_target, both far above 0.0053

passable_by_an_undertrained_model_measur.note: ALL FOUR 120-step pilots passed G9 while failing G2a and every other gate. This is the measured reason G9 is never read on its own and why the reading condition exists: all four sit far outside the 0.0389 m encoder band.

g9_threshold_derivation.reference_arm: v3 arm B (onboard, patch 14), which E0 re-runs
g9_threshold_derivation.rule: half of the reference arm's rollout excess. Exact half is 0.005288985 m; the threshold is that rounded to two significant figures, 0.2 % looser.
g9_threshold_derivation.size_against_v3_contrasts: the required reduction (0.53 cm) is 1.04x the C-A rollout contrast (0.51 cm) and 1.56x the D-B one (0.34 cm), the two contrasts TASK-052's conservative reading could NOT separate from sampling noise. It is of the same order as them, not comfortably larger. That is a real weakness of this threshold and it is recorded rather than dressed up.
g9_threshold_derivation.why_not_v2: v2's 0.39 cm was carried over, not recomputed: the v2 checkpoints have an incompatible implementation hash and this code cannot reproduce that figure
g9_threshold_derivation.why_not_v3_best: v3 arm D's 0.83 cm comes from the B<->D patch contrast, which TASK-052's conservative reading could not distinguish from its own sampling noise; a threshold at that value would be passable by noise alone

gate_definitions.G1: median palm-apple readout error at h=8 on predicted latents, val moving windows
gate_definitions.G2a: G1 divided by the model's own persistence readout on the same windows
gate_definitions.G2b: G1 divided by the shuffled-action control on the same windows
gate_definitions.G3: median apple-plate error at h=8 over all valid val windows
gate_definitions.G4: median absolute apple-height error at h=8 over the grasp cohort
gate_definitions.G5: AUROC of apple_held at h=8 over the lift cohort
gate_definitions.G6a: pooled within-state Spearman between predicted and true approach cost across the sibling candidate actions of one pre-grasp state, at h=16, over groups whose true costs span at least 5 mm
gate_definitions.G6b: median top-1 regret at h=16: the true approach cost of the candidate the model ranks best, minus the best true cost, over the same groups
gate_definitions.G7a: fraction of ordered sibling pairs at h=16 where the own-action prediction beats the swapped-action one
gate_definitions.G7b: Spearman between predicted and true sibling divergence at h=16
gate_definitions.G8a: collapsed fraction of encoded val latents
gate_definitions.G8b: effective rank of encoded val latents
gate_definitions.G9: median rollout excess at h=8 on the val moving windows: G1 minus the readout error of a directly encoded target-frame observation on the identical windows

leakage_discipline.test_episodes_decoded_is_a_literal: the field is emitted as a constant by the reporter. The real guarantee is structural: load_split refuses any split other than train/val and raises if the requested episodes intersect test or holdout, and train raises unless the manifest's normalization.episode_ids equals splits.train exactly.

measured_budget.source: disclosed pilots timing-{baseline,chunk,tail,step}, full corpus, 120 steps

not_frozen_arms.native_jepa: configs/apple_wm_v4.yaml exists and is the one-line backend swap, but is smoked only; the budget does not fit a fifth run. Its leworldmodel block is arm B's verbatim; its native_jepa block differs from v3's by the camera list, since v4 is one camera throughout.

pre_declared_outcomes.A_some_arm_other_than_E0_passes_g2a: CEM over this cost is kept; the winning arm (lowest G2a, ties by lower G9 then lower G1) is carried forward; the next protocol attacks the ENCODER term, with the single-frame 224 px information-ceiling measurement as the primary line. The closed loop still does not start.
pre_declared_outcomes.B_no_arm_passes_g2a: The control-formulation clause recorded by TASK-052 fires as written and is not deferred again: behaviour cloning with the world model as a critic or residual becomes the primary line, CEM over this cost is abandoned, and no further predictor-architecture protocol is preregistered.
pre_declared_outcomes.C_baseline_E0_passes_g2a: Takes precedence over A. The next protocol is a replication of the baseline at >= 3 seeds before any further architecture work.
pre_declared_outcomes.passes_g2a_means: the G2a gate passes, i.e. the value is <= 0.8, as the gate computes it
